title: Combining Comparators
summary: Shows the three logical operators (&&, ||, !) and uses && to give the love calculator three message bands: low, middle and high.

concepts.heading: Logical operators
points: && (AND) is true only when both conditions are true.
|| (OR), typed with two pipe characters, is true when at least one condition is true.
They combine several comparisons into one condition inside if (...).

concepts.heading: Three bands for the love score
points: Greater than 30 AND at most 70: the plain score alert.
At most 30: a message that the pair mixes badly.
The reference solution uses three separate if statements. Using >= and <= carefully keeps boundary values 30 and 70 in exactly one band.
(Extra) An else if chain would also work and avoids rechecking conditions.

code_examples.caption: Three bands

task.name: Extend the love calculator to three bands
task.starting_point: Love calculator with a single if/else on loveScore > 70.
task.goal: Give different alerts for scores above 70, from 31 to 70 and 30 or below.
steps: Keep the score generation and prompts.
Add a condition combining loveScore > 30 and loveScore <= 70 with &&.
Run repeatedly to see all three messages.
task.expected_result: Exactly one of three alerts appears depending on the score.

pitfalls: Overlapping or gapped ranges, e.g. > 30 and < 70 loses exactly 70.
Writing a single | or & instead of || and &&.
Typing 30 < loveScore < 70, which does not work as a range check.

playground.coverage: Covers &&, ||, !, truth tables, precedence and short-circuiting, but not the three-band love score.
gaps_and_ideas: Add a task to apply && to the three-band love calculator.
Add a boundary-test task for scores 30, 31, 70 and 71.
